scope: Updated lineup: documented API/SDK access and implemented read-only coverage. Documented access does not mean an adapter is built or execution enabled.

platforms.execution: Quote and build an unsigned transaction, sign locally, submit via execute or RPC.
platforms.tracking: Live read-only quote probe plus shared wallet balances; strategy attribution pending.
platforms.requirements: Production API key recommended; current docs also permit rate-limited keyless access. Local signing for execution.

platforms.initiative: Active spot trading - buy, sell, reinvest
platforms.execution: Server-built swap transactions; signing and execution remain disabled.
platforms.tracking: Live read-only quote probe plus shared wallet balances; fill attribution pending.
platforms.requirements: Token selection, allocation accounting and execution adapter pending.

platforms.execution: Documented position transaction builders; execution disabled.
platforms.tracking: Open long positions via GET /v1/positions; empty account verified; nonempty equity reconciliation pending.
platforms.requirements: Select market, fund collateral, verify fees and size limits before any execution.

platforms.access: REST and WebSocket APIs; official Python SDK
platforms.execution: Signed order placement and cancellation; documented order endpoint supports an optional agent wallet.
platforms.tracking: Venue positions, collateral, orders and fills in addition to on-chain deposits/withdrawals.

platforms.access: Official TypeScript/Rust SDKs and public data APIs

platforms.requirements: Select DLMM or DAMM and a pool; RPC and local signing. Account-creation/rent costs are separate from supplied liquidity.

platforms.access: REST APIs and official TypeScript SDK
platforms.execution: Build deposit/withdraw instructions for lending or Earn vaults; sign locally.
platforms.tracking: User positions, shares, exchange rates, interest and market data.
platforms.requirements: Choose the exact USDC reserve or vault and account type; RPC/signing requirements depend on integration path.

platforms.access: Official on-chain instructions, IDLs, pump-sdk and pump-swap-sdk
platforms.execution: Programmatic buy/sell on bonding curves and PumpSwap through official SDK transaction builders.
platforms.tracking: Solana balances, trade events, bonding curve state and migration into PumpSwap.
platforms.requirements: RPC and local signing. This is an official SDK/on-chain route, not a claim of an official public hosted REST trading API. Third-party PumpPortal is not Pump.fun.

platforms.access: Official Whirlpools SDK and on-chain accounts
platforms.tracking: Official SDK discovers mainnet SPL/Token-2022 positions and bundles; USD/fee valuation for nonempty positions remains pending.
platforms.requirements: Choose pool and price range; implement read-only position valuation.

platforms.access: Owned platform; public catalog and authenticated collector endpoints
platforms.execution: Disabled. Pack, budget and production network unresolved; no weekly schedule configured.
platforms.tracking: Paused by owner request; no catalog polling or purchase activity.
platforms.requirements: Owner will build a custom challenge pack; resume integration after pack/network configuration is supplied.

platforms.initiative: Create and launch our own memecoin
platforms.execution: Documented token creation route; no launch performed or scheduled.
platforms.tracking: Distinct mint, creation costs, own inventory, fees and realized proceeds; separate from station 7.
platforms.requirements: Choose name, symbol, metadata, mint and budget; explicit activation required.

backendImplications: The execution service is deployed but strictly disabled and has no signing credentials.
Ten strategies share one public wallet; stable strategy keys prevent replaced stations from inheriting old observations.
Token holdings alone cannot distinguish strategies. Allocation, fee and transaction attribution remains required.
Orca position reads are pending. Ript catalog reads do not track collector holdings or verify mainnet purchasing.
The $100 is a planned budget. Fees, rent, market minimums and Ript pack pricing remain to be budgeted.
Owner confirmed $100 strategy capital plus a separate SOL pool for fees and account rent; fee-pool accounting is separate from strategy capital.
Nine active read scopes have been implemented and checked against live sources; this is not funded execution validation. See funding-plan.md for remaining work.
